text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp said Tuesday it is "comfortable" with projecting 1996 earnings of $2.07-$2.09 per share before a one-time charge and costs related to its split-off from General Motors Corp.

EDS said it told analysts at a Salomon Brothers conference in New York that it estimated fourth quarter earnings would be hurt by $0.06-$0.08 per share because of Defense Department cuts and receivables that are due from an EDS customer in the midst of bankruptcy proceedings.
EDS said slow new contract signings in the first six months of 1996 also are expected to hurt fourth quarter earnings.
It said its long-term growth prospects "remain strong." The company signed new business totaling $2.81 billion in the third quarter and has a business backlog of more than $75 billion.
